functions.name: create_stream
functions.description: Create a recurring stream. An optional start_delay_ledgers adds a cliff period before accrual begins.

params.name: end_ledger
params.description: Absolute ledger at which the stream finishes accruing.

params.name: start_delay_ledgers
params.description: Number of ledgers after the current ledger before accrual begins. Stored as start_ledger = current + offset. A zero delay reproduces the original behaviour.

errors.name: InvalidDuration
errors.description: end_ledger must be greater than start_ledger.

acceptance: A zero delay reproduces current behaviour exactly
Total duration calculation still uses end_ledger - start_ledger so the drip rate is unchanged

functions.name: claimable_amount
functions.description: Returns the amount currently claimable by the recipient. Returns 0 before start_ledger.

functions.name: claim
functions.description: Claim accrued funds. Fails with CliffNotReached if called before start_ledger.

errors.name: CliffNotReached
errors.description: Claiming before the cliff (start_ledger) fails with a clear error rather than 'nothing to claim'.

acceptance: Claiming before the cliff fails with a clear error, not 'nothing to claim'
Tests for pre-cliff claim rejection and a post-cliff partial claim
